skill.description: Creates source-tagged SEO and GEO performance reports and configures threshold alerts for traffic, rankings, technical health, backlinks, competitors, and AI visibility.

skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, relative documentation links, KPI terminology, and metadata URLs. The skill does direct the host to run a Python ledger command, and its unquoted domain placeholder creates a potential command-injection path. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious traversal intent was found.

remediation.issue: The ledger command places the user-supplied domain directly in shell syntax.
remediation.suggestion: Validate domains against a strict hostname pattern and pass arguments through a structured process API without shell interpolation.

remediation.issue: The skill directs the host to execute a bundled Python ledger command.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit consent before execution and document the script path, expected files, data written, and failure behavior.

content.user_title: Monitor SEO Performance and Configure Alerts
content.value_statement: SEO teams struggle to compare scattered metrics and detect meaningful declines before they become costly. This skill creates source-tagged reports and configurable alert plans using baselines, thresholds, priorities, and response actions.
actual_capabilities: Builds comparative SEO and GEO reports covering traffic, rankings, authority, backlinks, content, conversions, and AI citations.
Configures threshold alerts for ranking, traffic, technical, backlink, competitor, brand, and AI visibility changes.
Labels every metric as measured, user-provided, estimated, or unavailable.
Tailors report structures for executives, marketers, engineers, and client teams.
Produces prioritized recommendations with owners, timing, and expected impact.
Uses baselines, controls, and fixed readback windows to evaluate changes.
limitations: Requires connected data tools or user exports because it cannot create missing measurements.
Does not compute CORE-EEAT, CITE scores, or raw position-by-position ranking changes.
Produces alert configurations, but actual scheduling and delivery depend on host integrations.
Default thresholds are general references and require tuning for seasonality and normal volatility.

use_cases.title: Prepare a monthly executive report
use_cases.description: Compare current and prior SEO results, summarize business impact, and assign the highest-priority actions.

use_cases.title: Design an early-warning system
use_cases.description: Define traffic, ranking, backlink, and AI visibility alerts with thresholds, routing, cooldowns, and response owners.

use_cases.title: Review technical search health
use_cases.description: Track indexation, crawl errors, Core Web Vitals, schema status, and technical debt for engineering prioritization.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic performance report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a report for [domain] covering [period] versus [comparison period]. Use available data, label every metric source, and list three prioritized actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a clear recurring SEO summary.

prompt_templates.title: Configure focused monitoring alerts
prompt_templates.prompt: Configure alerts for [domain] across traffic, rankings, and technical health. Use [baseline period], then define thresholds, priorities, delivery channels, cooldowns, and response owners.
prompt_templates.scenario: A marketing team needs practical alerts without excessive noise.

prompt_templates.title: Build a technical performance review
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a technical SEO report for [domain] using [data sources]. Compare indexation, crawl errors, Core Web Vitals, and schema health against [comparison period]. Separate observations from explanations and assign each action an owner, deadline, and expected impact.
prompt_templates.scenario: An engineering team needs evidence-based technical priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Combine reporting with control-based monitoring
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a combined quarterly report and monitoring plan for [domain]. Segment brand and non-brand performance, compare against controls, and define readback windows. Configure alerts only for material changes and include escalation, suppression, and rollback criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced team needs reporting, alerting, and decision controls in one workflow.

output_examples.input: Create an executive SEO report for example.com for June versus May.
output: Overall status: Watch. Organic sessions fell 18 percent month over month, while conversions remained stable.
Priority action: Review the five declining landing pages and assign refresh owners by Friday.
Data gap: AI citation coverage was not evaluated because no source was connected.

output_examples.input: Configure traffic alerts using the last 28 days as the baseline.
output: Critical traffic alert: Trigger when weekly organic sessions fall 30 percent below the trailing baseline.
Route immediately to email and Slack, suppress duplicates for 24 hours, and assign the SEO manager.
Open a 14-day readback window before declaring recovery or rollback.

output_examples.input: Prepare a technical SEO health report for the engineering lead.
output: Indexation status: Off track because valid indexed pages declined while excluded errors increased.
Immediate action: Validate sitemap coverage and recent robots changes, then assign an owner.
Core Web Vitals remain not evaluated until current field data is provided.

best_practices: Provide a current period, comparison period, target audience, and business goals.
Confirm each data source and freshness date before interpreting movement.
Tune thresholds against normal volatility, seasonality, and alert response capacity.
anti_patterns: Do not invent values when a source or export is unavailable.
Do not present a plausible explanation as a confirmed cause without supporting evidence.
Do not apply default alert thresholds without checking the domain baseline.

faq.question: Can this skill fetch SEO data automatically?
faq.answer: It can use connected tools when available. Otherwise, provide analytics, Search Console, ranking, backlink, or AI visibility exports.

faq.question: Does it send and schedule alerts?
faq.answer: It creates alert rules, routing, and response plans. Actual scheduling and delivery require compatible host integrations.

faq.question: Which report audiences are supported?
faq.answer: It supports executive, marketing, technical, and client-focused report structures.

faq.question: What happens when data is missing?
faq.answer: The skill marks the metric as not evaluated or unavailable and continues without fabricating a value.

faq.question: Does it calculate CITE or CORE-EEAT scores?
faq.answer: No. It reports existing scores and trends, then directs new scoring work to the appropriate audit skill.

faq.question: Can the results be saved?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill asks for confirmation before writing a dated summary under the monitoring memory directory.
